title: Fuzzer: `FuzzySearch.search_all` crashes Godot
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable4960 = FuzzySearch.new()
	temp_variable4960.set_max_results(-96)
	temp_variable4960.search_all("5555", PackedStringArray(["", "3446985970", ".", "127.0.0.1", "5555", ".", "127.0.0.1", "5555", "", "127.0.0.1", ".", "5555", "127.0.0.1", "5555", "5555", "3516181556", "", "", ".", ".", ".", ".", "127.0.0.1", "127.0.0.1", "845391438"]))

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
